keys.admin.tools.upload_ai_step2: Open your favourite Artificial Intelligence app (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini...) and upload the schema.json file you downloaded.
keys.admin.tools.upload_ai_step3: Copy and paste the following prompt:
keys.admin.tools.upload_ai_step4: Right after the prompt, paste your list of questions and answers and send it to the AI. Download the .json it returns and upload it below.
keys.admin.tools.upload_ai_prompt:
Act as an expert question bank generator for the Xiro! platform.

I have uploaded a file called schema.json that defines the exact structure (fields, data types and format) a valid question bank must have.

Your task:
1. Read and analyse schema.json carefully: identify the required fields, the supported question types and the exact format of each one (including the case of the keys).
2. Below this message I will paste a list of questions and answers in free text.
3. Turn that list into a SINGLE JSON object that matches the structure of schema.json EXACTLY: same field names, same data types and same hierarchy.
4. If I do not specify the type of a question, assume "quiz" (only one correct) with 4 options where only one is correct.
5. If the text of any question or answer is too long to read comfortably on screen, shorten it while keeping its meaning and its keywords. Apply this to both questions and answers, without changing which answer is correct.
6. Do not add fields that do not exist in the schema and do not omit required ones. Do not include comments or explanations.
7. In "numeric_approximation" questions: "correctAnswer" must be an INTEGER, with no decimals (if the real figure has decimals, rephrase the question in another unit or round it and say so in the question); "maxPoints" must be an integer greater than 0 (use 100); "toleranceMode" must be "absolute", "percentage" or "hybrid"; "toleranceValue" and "toleranceCap" must be numbers GREATER THAN 0, never 0 or negative, adjusted to the magnitude of the answer.
8. In "word_scramble" questions: "correctWord" must be ONE single word in UPPERCASE with EXACTLY between 7 and 10 letters, no more and no fewer, with no spaces, hyphens, digits or symbols. If the answer does not fit that length, choose another word or rephrase the question.
9. Return ONLY the final JSON, valid and well-formed, ready to be saved as a .json file.
